pairs.subject: agent-runtime-assembly
pairs.evidence: app/api/intake/[id]/message/route.ts:99 Each intake/apply route runs a single bounded model exchange through a spawned Python child (runIntakeExchange) and stores the whole transcript row with a compare-and-swap. There is no hook chain, no contributed code, no tool loop, no remote work that outlives a turn and no checkpoint representation for this subject to govern. A case-insensitive search of app/api/apply and app/api/intake for plugin, checkpoint, subagent, toolCall and tool_use found nothing (the only 'hook' hits are node:module registerHooks in test files).

techniques.evidence: app/api/intake/[id]/message/route.ts:193 The unit is one model call, with no loop and no model-call boundary to inject at. A message that overlaps an in-flight turn is refused 409 by the CAS, which is the fallback the technique itself names.

pairs.subject: agent-runtime-assembly
pairs.evidence: app/api/devcase/lifecycle/route.ts:80 The lifecycle routes (approve, close, redesign, inbound, feedback, list) are CRUD and gate doors that hand the orchestration to the task runner and return its id. No agent runtime is assembled here: no hook chain, no extension loading, no checkpoint store. A search of app/api/devcase for plugin, checkpoint, subagent, toolCall and tool_use found nothing.

pairs.subject: agent-runtime-assembly
pairs.evidence: app/api/devcase/session/[id]/chat/route.ts:123 The candidate session chat is one bounded model call per request through a spawned Python child: the history is read from dev_session_chat, the user turn is appended and one reply is stored. No hook chain, no contributed code, no tool loop and no delta or full checkpoint choice exists for the subject to govern. A search of app/api/devcase for plugin, checkpoint, subagent, toolCall and tool_use found nothing.

techniques.evidence: app/api/devcase/session/[id]/chat/route.ts:105 The input is recorded before the request that uses it, but there is no running multi-call unit to steer, so the technique's precondition does not hold.
